title: Vault routing (<vault>/_machine/routing.yml)
description: Where a labelled thought goes. targets names each destination and the adapter that delivers to it; rules are a set, not a sequence: every rule whose match holds delivers to every target in its to, so one rule never shadows another. Read by ingest's dispatch-targets and ingest-status; label names in match are rewritten only by label-bank rename and merge.

adapter.description: An adapter the vault plugin ships (ingest's scripts/adapters/<adapter>). A name, never a path.

params.description: Passed to the adapter verbatim with every thought.

to.description: Target names, each declared under targets.

pattern.description: A label, or a glob on labels where * matches any run of characters (project:*). A bare * holds for every thought, even one with no labels.

oneOf.description: Holds when at least one label matches one pattern.
Holds when no label matches any pattern. This is how a fallback is expressed without ordering.
